08a8c487f74e44fb0769abaa.title_original: When Tool Names Are Not Identities: Measuring Provider Misbinding in MCP-Based AI Agents
08a8c487f74e44fb0769abaa.excerpt: arXiv:2611.21577v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly act as agents that select and invoke external tools. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes this interaction by allowing clients to compose tools advertised by multiple servers. However, tool metadata used for discovery and selection is not, by itself, necessarily bound to a verified provider identity. This paper studies this gap as tool-provider misbinding: a failure in which a request intended for a legitimate provider is instead resolved to an attacker-controlled tool. The attacker does not compromise the host, LLM, legitimate server, or network channel; it only operates another MCP server that advertises tools with chosen metadata. We formulate tool provider misbinding as an attacker-controlled tool-selection optimization problem and evaluate it in a controlled MCP environment across five LLM-based clients. The results show that interactions drive misbinding. The strongest failures occur when exact-name collision, task-aligned description, and compatible schema reinforce one another, but authority-enhanced descriptions with compatible schema can also cause wrong-provider execution or unresolved provider ambiguity without name collision. Different models expose the same provider-binding weakness differently, including attacker-controlled provider selection, clarification requests, and unstable or inconsistent provider resolution.

3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.title_original: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.excerpt: arXiv:2611.21053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.

3acf9d21f854b4b0558811cc.background_ko: 클라우드 LLM은 환자 데이터 노출 우려가 있고, 로컬 LLM이 도구 호출에 만들어 낸 값은 이후 처리 단계로 전파될 수 있다는 문제가 연구의 출발점이다.

429a29127df333c850151ff8.title_original: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
429a29127df333c850151ff8.excerpt: arXiv:2611.20398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. 53bb135186a700d392f3cfd2.title_original: NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation
53bb135186a700d392f3cfd2.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19332v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. be488a49ba6fb154a3be9df7.title_original: Recovery Gone Too Far: Understanding and Repairing Risky Fallback in LLM Agents
be488a49ba6fb154a3be9df7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19886v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. When a tool fails with an ordinary error, such as a rate limit or a timeout, the agent can fall back to a substitute tool and still complete the task. However, the same fallback that completes a task in one environment can cross an action boundary in another. For example, after a push is rejected, a forced push in one repository replaces only the agent's own commits, while in a different repository it also removes another author's commits. All four mainstream models we evaluate exhibit risky fallback, with action-boundary violations in up to 96.8% of risky scenarios. We further evaluate three mainstream mitigations and find that none of them is effective against risky fallback. We then present nrepair. At each call to the substitute tool, nrepair scores the agent's context with a monitor whose threshold is calibrated on normal runs alone; when the monitor triggers, it withholds the call once and returns the decision to the agent. nrepair reduces action-boundary violations on all four models, by up to 76.0% (from 67.5% to 16.2%), at a negligible runtime cost. d520880abd38fbc738144af2.title_original: Compositional Exploits in Autonomous Coding Agents: Attack Mechanics and Ephemeral Defense
d520880abd38fbc738144af2.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenHands) rely on third-party tools to inspect files, run commands, and call external APIs. Today's security auditors evaluate these tools almost entirely in isolation: static linters and AST checkers verify that each individual tool contains no malicious code at installation time. In this paper, we show that isolated tool auditing is fundamentally flawed. We expose compositional exploits in autonomous coding agents, an emergent vulnerability class where an agent chains individually harmless tools to execute an unauthorized attack. Much like code-reuse attacks in binary exploitation, this threat requires no malware; instead, the agent stitches together legitimate tool operations across turns over shared workspace files, environment variables, and chat memory. Across a 560-task benchmark suite (360 exploit tasks across 8 hazard classes and 200 benign developer and cloud workflows), unprotected frontier models (Gemini 3.5, 3.7, and 3.8 Flash) execute compositional exploit chains with a 72.9% to 84.5% success rate, while five leading single-tool pre-distribution scanners exhibit a 0% detection rate across all constituent tools. d520880abd38fbc738144af2.summary_ko: 연구진은 개별적으로 무해한 도구를 연쇄 사용해 무단 공격을 수행하는 코딩 에이전트 취약점을 제시했다. 560개 과제 평가에서 무방비 모델의 공격 성공률은 72.9~84.5%였고, 단일 도구 검사기 5종의 탐지율은 0%였다고 보고했다. 제안한 CompGuard는 실험에서 공격 차단율 100%, 정상 개발 과제 해결률 98.0%를 기록했다고 밝혔다.

60fc3038701d3c4ac72202e4.title_original: ElevatorII: High-Performance Fully-Static Cross-ISA Binary Translation
60fc3038701d3c4ac72202e4.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The established method for running software compiled for one instruction-set architecture (ISA) on a different ISA is by emulation in conjunction with just-in-time (JIT) compilation. This requires run-time support on the target that needs to be trusted and whose compilation decisions are hard to predict or reconstruct. We present ElevatorII, a fully static, ahead-of-time cross-ISA binary-to-binary compiler from x86 to AArch64 that challenges the established consensus. Our approach eliminates the need for run-time support on the target, removes the hard to reproduce effects of dynamic compilation, and provides the capability to exhaustively test the actual binary that is eventually executed. Our approach combines superset disassembly with observation-guided path selection. Superset disassembly overcomes the code vs. data differentiation problem by creating a separate control flow path for every possible interpretation of every byte in the input binary. It guarantees that there is pre-translated code for every possible jump destination in the original text segment, even for computed jumps that are not statically decidable. Static and observation-guided path selection then creates additional optimized "confirmed code paths" that overlay the regular grid. 60fc3038701d3c4ac72202e4.title_ko: ElevatorII, 런타임 지원 없이 x86을 AArch64로 변환하는 정적 컴파일러 제안

78ac323a3ce89a78fb7f519c.title_original: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs
78ac323a3ce89a78fb7f519c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.20119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances. On the Qwen3-30B-A3B model, CECAR achieves 12.5 tokens/s on a consumer-grade GPU with only 16 GB of VRAM, where non-resident experts are fetched from SSD, delivering a 4.5x speedup over conventional MoE inference and exceeding the decode speed of baselines that keep the entire model fully resident in DRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/CECAR.

7a1ba4b0092e4388cf46dab1.title_original: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
7a1ba4b0092e4388cf46dab1.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

8a7f22caafaff6d8abcda020.title_original: Analog Resonant Recurrent Neural Networks via Metacircuits
8a7f22caafaff6d8abcda020.excerpt: arXiv:2604.17277v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physical neural networks offer a promising route to fast and energy-efficient edge intelligence by embedding computation in the intrinsic dynamics of materials and devices. However, processing temporal signals requires recurrent networks with memory, whose trained dynamics are hard to reproduce faithfully in physical systems. Here we present an analog resonant recurrent neural network (R$^2$NN) implemented as a metacircuit of coupled local resonators. A reformulated mechanical-electrical analogy based on frequency-dependent negative resistances maps a trained network one-to-one onto the metacircuit, with every trainable parameter realized as a resistance. Training tunes local resonances and global resistive couplings so that past responses persist as recurrent memory and interfere with incoming inputs, and the resulting impedance landscape routes different frequencies to distinct outputs. Exploiting this recurrent memory, the metacircuit solves a temporal-parity task whose output depends on the entire input history. Building on the learned frequency selectivity, stand-alone R$^2$NN systems classify raw tactile, acoustic and vibration signals in real time and directly drive downstream hardware. This work establishes engineered locally resonant dynamics as a physical substrate for recurrent neural computation and opens a route to compact, low-latency neural hardware for machine intelligence at the edge.

09a2ca5ec574bc77f2190a31.title_original: Security for the agentic era, powered by Microsoft Perception
09a2ca5ec574bc77f2190a31.excerpt: In this article A new cyber stack, built to fight AI with AI Delivering agentic security at Microsoft Ignite Secure your foundations Defend with agents Secure agentic insiders Changing how security work gets done Explore what's new A year ago, finding a serious, exploitable vulnerability was slow and expensive work done by elite security researchers. That’s no longer true. Over the past 12 months, frontier AI models have become remarkably good at discovering and exploiting software vulnerabilities, and similar levels of capability are quickly becoming available in open weights models with limited cyber guardrails. Attacks that once required specialized resources are now within reach of almost anyone. We saw what that looks like in a single week this fall when PHP disclosed two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, flaws that let an attacker take control of a server with a single request over the internet. 1 At the time of disclosure, tens of millions of internet-facing PHP services were running affected versions. Nearly two weeks later, about 29 million services remained vulnerable. Behind those servers are banks, healthcare providers, energy companies, and much of the infrastructure the internet runs on. And that same day brought five other major disclosures across the industry. cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.title_original: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
cffc2d320502e3eae4b9d034.excerpt: arXiv:2611.20771v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.

d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.title_ko: Cisco Talos, OpenJDK 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-114938 공개
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.summary_ko: Cisco Talos는 OpenJDK Java 17.0.6 이상에서 조작된 Base64 입력으로 인증 없이 원격 코드 실행이 가능할 수 있는 취약점을 공개했다. AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 x86-64 환경이 대상이며 CVSS 4.0 점수는 9.2라고 설명했다. 실제 악용은 아직 관측되지 않았으며, 업데이트 적용이나 JVM의 AVX-512 사용 비활성화를 권고했다.
d9e8489da6a8a1658607a307.background_ko: Talos에 따르면 AVX-512 VBMI가 활성화된 일부 x86-64 JVM에서 잘못된 Base64 입력을 처리할 때 원격 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 특정 CPU 환경의 OpenJDK에서 비인증 코드 실행 가능성이 공개돼 영향 환경 확인이 시급하다.

f1632157e7fc152502de9193.title_ko: Docker Hub 이미지에 노출된 AWS 키, 실험서 최단 7.86초 만에 악용

curation.reason_ko: 미끼 이미지 실험에서 노출 AWS 키가 수초 내 사용돼 컨테이너 공개 전 비밀정보 검사의 중요성을 보였다.

8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.title_ko: TOCTOU 경쟁 상태 재현과 수정 검증을 위한 Chronos 프레임워크 제안
8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.summary_ko: 연구진이 검사 시점과 사용 시점 사이의 경쟁 상태인 TOCTOU를 재현하고 수정 여부를 판정하는 Chronos를 제안했다. 개입 시점과 판정 근거를 분리하고, 수정 판정에 명시적 증거를 요구한다. 취약한 빌드에서 개입이 실패한 실험을 평가한 결과, 기존 결과 기반 검사기는 800건 넘게 수정됐다고 오판했지만 Chronos에서는 이런 오판이 없었다고 보고했다.
8688aff3472ded49101fd4d2.background_ko: TOCTOU 경쟁 상태는 재현이 어렵고 공격이 타이밍 경쟁에서 실패하면 취약한 프로그램도 수정된 것처럼 보일 수 있다는 문제가 연구 배경이다.

curation.reason_ko: 경쟁 상태 재현 실패를 수정 성공으로 오판하지 않도록 명시적 판정 근거를 요구하는 검증 체계를 제시했다.

a9b95f6a1d0af26af9704ed8.title_ko: 일본 RIKEN, 보안 침해로 슈퍼컴퓨터 Fugaku 가동 중단
a9b95f6a1d0af26af9704ed8.summary_ko: 일본 RIKEN이 내부 서버 침입과 악성코드 설치를 확인하고 11월 14일 슈퍼컴퓨터 Fugaku 가동을 중단했다. Fugaku·Rikyu 사용자 개인정보와 사용자 컴퓨터에 저장된 인증키·연구 데이터 파일이 침해됐다고 밝혔다. 추가 시스템의 무단 접근이나 연구 결과 탈취는 확인되지 않았으며, 정확한 침입 방식은 조사 중이다.

curation.reason_ko: 침해 확인으로 Fugaku가 중단되고 인증키·연구 데이터 파일도 침해돼 연구 인프라 보안에 중요하다.

7b20341e869cf25dd2ec7834.title_original: Memory Safety Isn't All You Need: Code Reuse Attacks in Memory Safe Languages
7b20341e869cf25dd2ec7834.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Memory safety rules out classical code reuse attacks that rely on arbitrary memory corruption, but does not eliminate code reuse altogether. Attacks such as object injection, prototype pollution, class pollution, DOM clobbering, and DOM script gadgets arise in memory-safe languages without violating the underlying memory safety abstraction. We show that these seemingly different attacks share a common structure: Attacker-controlled data influences accesses to shared runtime state, such as runtime type information, prototype or class state, and the DOM, and a value fetched from that state subsequently influences a security-sensitive operation. Drawing on this insight, we develop a language-agnostic framework that decomposes an attack into a weakness, ending in a fetch from shared runtime state, and a gadget, which propagates the fetched value to a sensitive sink. We show that the framework captures five established attack classes and use it to derive stateless, mutating, and recycling weaknesses, together with simple, vertical, and horizontal gadget structures. We further systematize existing defenses into three common strategies - mediation, minimization, and constraint - and use them to derive candidate defense directions. Finally, we develop a model language that gives a formal account of code-reuse weaknesses and potential conditions for gadgets and end-to-end vulnerabilities.

7b20341e869cf25dd2ec7834.summary_ko: 연구진은 메모리 안전 언어의 객체 주입·프로토타입 오염 등에서 공격자 데이터가 공유 런타임 상태를 거쳐 보안상 민감한 연산에 영향을 주는 공통 구조를 제시했다. 이를 약점과 가젯으로 나누는 언어 독립적 프레임워크로 기존 공격 5종을 설명하고, 방어 전략과 잠재적 취약점 조건을 체계화했다.

06b7231e1c980e8fd0572624.title_original: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
06b7231e1c980e8fd0572624.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. 06b7231e1c980e8fd0572624.background_ko: 기존 평가는 단일 실행의 운과 실력을 구분하기 어렵고, 모델의 과거 데이터 기억이나 뉴스·가격 결합 방식으로 미래 정보가 섞일 수 있다는 문제가 제기됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미래 정보 참조를 통제한 평가에서 유의한 알파를 찾지 못했다고 보고해 AI 거래 수익 주장 검토에 유용하다.

9b9e7f9af4551b06c5ad0da2.title_original: 공중에서 줄을 엮어 물건 운반…신기한 '드론 기술'
9b9e7f9af4551b06c5ad0da2.excerpt: 여러 대의 드론이 공중에서 줄을 엮어 물체를 묶고 운반하는 기술이 개발됐습니다. 미국 오클랜드대와 리하이대 공동 연구팀은 로봇팔이나 집게 없이 줄만으로 물체를 붙잡는 드론 협력 기술을 선보였습니다. 드론들은 물체 주변을 비행하며 줄을 여러 겹으로 교차시켜 감습니다. 이때 발생하는 마찰력을 이용해 물체를 단단히 고정합니다. 이후 물체를 함께 들어 올려 운반하고 목적지에 도착하면 줄을 자동으로 풀어 내려놓습니다. 연구진은 이 모든 과정을 사람의 직
9b9e7f9af4551b06c5ad0da2.title_ko: 여러 드론이 공중에서 줄 엮어 물체 운반…자율 협력 기술 실험
9b9e7f9af4551b06c5ad0da2.summary_ko: 미국 오클랜드대와 리하이대 연구팀이 여러 드론이 줄을 엮어 물체를 고정하고 운반하는 협력 기술을 선보였다. 드론은 줄을 여러 겹으로 감아 생기는 마찰력으로 물체를 붙잡고 운반 후 자동으로 풀어 내려놓으며, 연구진은 사람의 직접 조종 없이 전체 과정을 실제 드론 실험으로 검증했다고 밝혔다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 여러 드론의 줄 엮기·운반·해제를 실제 실험으로 검증했다고 밝혀 협력 로봇 기술에 의미가 있다.

b47aebe2fd1bbf151719e691.title_original: 분리된 보안 환경서 자료 검색부터 승인까지...워크사인, 한국 시장 공략
b47aebe2fd1bbf151719e691.excerpt: 실리콘밸리 기반 기업 워크사인(대표 김만수)이 보안 컨테이너 기술을 적용한 기업 맞춤형 AI 솔루션 '워크사인'을 국내 시장에 출시한다고 17일 밝혔다.워크사인은 기업이 설정한 권한 범위 내에서 AI가 업무 초안을 준비하고 담당자가 이를 검토 및 승인하는 방식의 서비스다. 직원이 업무 목표와 범위를 지정하면 AI가 사내 자료를 검색 및 정리해 보고서나 고객 제안서, 회의록 등의 초안을 작성한다. 이후 담당자가 내용과 수신자 등을 확인하고 최종 발송이나 실행을 승인한다.기업마다 사용하는 내부 시스템과 데이터, 승인 절차가 다르다는 점
b47aebe2fd1bbf151719e691.title_ko: 워크사인, 독립 보안 컨테이너 기반 기업용 AI 국내 출시
b47aebe2fd1bbf151719e691.summary_ko: 워크사인이 독립된 보안 컨테이너에서 작동하는 기업 맞춤형 AI 솔루션을 국내에 출시한다고 밝혔다. AI가 허가된 사내 자료로 업무 초안을 작성하고 담당자가 최종 실행을 승인하며, 문서에 숨은 악성 명령이나 권한 밖 작업을 차단하기 위해 접근 범위 설정·승인 관리·활동 기록 기능을 운영한다.
b47aebe2fd1bbf151719e691.background_ko: 기업마다 내부 시스템과 데이터, 승인 절차가 다르다는 점을 고려해 도입 환경에 맞춘 AI 솔루션을 마련했다.

curation.reason_ko: 권한 범위와 사람의 승인을 결합한 기업용 AI의 국내 출시를 발표했으며 보안 기능은 회사 설명이다.

hot.reason_ko: 인증 없이 루트 권한을 얻는 취약점의 실제 악용이 보고돼 ESG 운영자의 긴급 패치가 필요하다.
특정 비기본 설정의 Confluence·N-central에서 원격 코드 실행 취약점 악용이 보고돼 대응이 시급하다.
접근 키 유출이 악성 확장 배포로 이어졌으며, 회사 추산 최대 5천 명이 영향받은 AI 개발 공급망 사고다.
MSP 서버 42곳을 겨냥한 공격과 악성 클라이언트 설치가 관찰돼 원격관리 환경의 대응이 시급하다.
중국 기업의 해외 GPU 원격 이용과 훈련 위탁까지 통제하는 규정으로, AI 인프라 사업의 중요 변수다.
약 24시간의 전 세계 장애로 주요 업무 도구가 영향을 받았으며, 연쇄 장애 원인에 대한 예비 조사 결과가 나왔다.
약 2만5천 건의 계정정보와 암호화 비밀번호가 유출돼 국내 이용자의 계정 보호 조치가 시급하다.
학생 주소·통학 노선·학부모 연락처 유출이 확인돼 학생 개인정보와 이동 안전 측면에서 중요한 국내 사고다.
공격자가 고객 연동 자격증명 보관 시스템에 접근해 재발급이 요청됐다. 정보 탈취 증거는 확인되지 않았다.

CVE-2026-91569.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle WebLogic Server product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: TopLink Integration). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0, 14.1.2.0.0 and 15.1.1.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. While the vulnerability is in Oracle WebLogic Server, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle WebLogic Server. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle WebLogic Server의 TopLink 통합 기능을 비인증 HTTP 공격으로 장악해 다른 제품에도 영향을 줄 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114835.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Access Manager product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Admin Console). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.2.1.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Access Manager. While the vulnerability is in Oracle Access Manager, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Access Manager. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle Access Manager 관리 콘솔을 비인증 HTTP 공격으로 장악할 수 있으며 다른 제품에도 영향이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-91500.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Access Manager product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Authentication Engine). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.2.1.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Access Manager. While the vulnerability is in Oracle Access Manager, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Access Manager accessible data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Access Manager accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle Access Manager. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle Access Manager 인증 엔진에서 비인증 데이터 탈취·변조와 부분적 서비스 거부가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-114202.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

curation.reason_ko: ASUS Control Center Express의 고정 암호화 키로 인증 토큰을 위조해 관리자 권한을 얻을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-126552.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function, OS Command Injection vulnerability in Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation (Workload Control Center (WCC) modules) on Windows, Linux allows OS Command Injection.This issue affects AutoSys Workload Automation: from 12.1 through 24.0.01.
CVE-2026-126552.summary_ko: Windows·Linux용 Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation의 WCC 모듈에 핵심 기능 인증 누락 및 운영체제 명령 삽입 취약점이 있어 명령 삽입이 가능하다. 영향 버전은 12.1부터 24.0.01까지다.
CVE-2026-126552.background_ko: 핵심 기능에 필요한 인증이 누락돼 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Broadcom AutoSys의 WCC 모듈에서 핵심 기능 인증 누락으로 비인증 운영체제 명령 삽입이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-126551.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key vulnerability in Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation (Workload Control Center (WCC) modules) on Windows, Linux allows Session Credential Falsification through Forging.This issue affects AutoSys Workload Automation: from 12.1 through 24.2.00.
CVE-2026-126551.summary_ko: Windows·Linux용 Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation의 WCC 모듈에서 하드코딩된 암호화 키를 사용해 세션 자격 증명을 위조할 수 있다. 영향 버전은 12.1부터 24.2.00까지다.

curation.reason_ko: Broadcom AutoSys의 WCC 모듈이 고정 암호화 키를 사용해 세션 자격 증명 위조가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-126553.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation (Workload Control Center (WCC) modules) on Windows, Linux allows Object Injection.This issue affects AutoSys Workload Automation: from 12.1 through 24.0.01.
CVE-2026-126553.summary_ko: Windows·Linux용 Broadcom AutoSys Workload Automation의 WCC 모듈에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 있어 객체 삽입이 가능하다. 영향 버전은 12.1부터 24.0.01까지다.

curation.reason_ko: Broadcom AutoSys의 WCC 모듈에서 비신뢰 데이터 역직렬화로 비인증 객체 삽입이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-114824.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Platform Security for Java product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Centralized Thirdparty Jars). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.2.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Platform Security for Java. While the vulnerability is in Oracle Platform Security for Java, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Platform Security for Java. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle Platform Security for Java를 비인증 HTTP 공격으로 장악해 다른 제품에도 영향을 줄 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114952.description: Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Client programs). Supported versions that are affected are MySQL Server: 8.4.0-8.4.13, 9.7.0-9.7.4, 26.10; MySQL Cluster: 8.0.0-8.0.50, 8.4.0-8.4.13, 9.7.0-9.7.4 and 26.10. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster accessible data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N).

curation.reason_ko: MySQL Server·Cluster의 클라이언트 프로그램 취약점으로 비인증 공격자가 중요 데이터를 읽고 변조할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114849.description: Vulnerability in Oracle APEX (component: General). Supported versions that are affected are 24.1.22, 24.2.21, 26.1.5 and 26.2.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTPS to compromise Oracle APEX. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle APEX. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle APEX에서 비인증 원격 공격자가 사용자 개입 없이 제품을 장악할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114924.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Application Object Library product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Core). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Application Object Library. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Application Object Library. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle E-Business Suite의 핵심 라이브러리를 비인증 HTTP 공격으로 장악할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114925.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Applications Framework product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: REST Services). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Applications Framework. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Applications Framework. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

curation.reason_ko: Oracle E-Business Suite의 REST 서비스로 비인증 공격자가 프레임워크를 장악할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-91456.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle WebLogic Server product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Core). Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0, 14.1.2.0.0 and 15.1.1.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via SOAP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle WebLogic Server. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts). CVE-2026-119293.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. In 1.11.2 and earlier, rtp_common_read() in src/switch_rtp.c uses one session-wide autoadj_tally to learn RTP sources that differ from the address negotiated in SDP. An unauthenticated remote attacker who sends plaintext RTP during call setup can make packets from one or more non-advertised sources reach the threshold before the legitimate endpoint, causing FreeSWITCH to adopt the source of the threshold-crossing packet as the media peer. The attacker can then receive call audio, inject media, and deny media to the legitimate endpoint without being on the media path. FreeSWITCH 1.11.2 adds two opt-in controls, but both default to zero and the release remains affected unless both are configured before RTP session creation. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.11.2.

curation.reason_ko: FreeSWITCH의 RTP 출처 학습 결함으로 비인증 통화 도청·음성 주입이 가능하며 기본 설정도 영향을 받는다.

CVE-2026-130622.description: Incorrect authorization in the credential loading logic in AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes (aws-privateca-issuer) before 1.12.0 might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to create namespace-scoped issuers to obtain certificates, including subordinate CA certificates, signed by another namespace's AWS Private CA with that namespace's stored AWS credentials, via a namespace-scoped issuer that references a credentials Secret in that namespace. To remediate this issue, users should first copy any credentials Secret they intend a namespace-scoped issuer to use into that issuer's namespace and update the issuer's secretRef.namespace to match. Then, upgrade aws-privateca-issuer to version 1.12.0 or the AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes EKS add-on to version v1.12.0-eksbuild.1.

curation.reason_ko: AWS Private CA의 Kubernetes 커넥터에서 다른 네임스페이스 자격 증명으로 하위 CA 인증서 발급이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-130623.description: Incorrect authorization in the credential handling for namespace-scoped issuers in AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes (aws-privateca-issuer) before 1.12.0 might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to create namespace-scoped issuers to obtain certificates, including subordinate CA certificates, from every AWS Private CA and certificate template reachable by the controller's own AWS identity or by any IAM role that identity can assume. This happens because a namespace-scoped issuer that supplies no credentials, or sets only a role, falls back to the controller's own identity. To remediate this issue, users should first update any namespace-scoped issuers that rely on the controller's identity to use their own credentials. Then, upgrade aws-privateca-issuer to version 1.12.0 or the AWS Private CA Connector for Kubernetes EKS add-on to version v1.12.0-eksbuild.1.

curation.reason_ko: AWS Private CA 커넥터의 신원 대체 동작으로 발급자 생성 권한자가 컨트롤러 권한의 하위 CA 인증서를 얻을 수 있다.

Atlassian recommends that Jira Service Management Data Center customers upgrade to latest version, if you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions: * Jira Service Management Data Center 10.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.3.27 * Jira Service Management Data Center 11.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.3.13 See the release notes (https://confluence.atlassian.com/servicemanagement/jira-service-management-release-notes-780083086.html). This Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 8.7 and a CVSS Vector of CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N allows an unauthenticated attacker to expose assets in your environment susceptible to exploitation, which has high impact to confidentiality, no impact to integrity, no impact to availability, and requires no user interaction. Atlassian recommends that Confluence Data Center and Server customers upgrade to the latest version. If you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions: Confluence Data Center 11.0: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.0.1 Confluence Data Center 10.2: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.2.20 Confluence Data Center 9.2: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 9.2.27 See the release notes ([https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/confluence-release-notes-327.html]). CVE-2026-100397.description: Rucio is a scientific data management framework. From 1.14.0 until 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1, validate_auth_token in lib/rucio/core/authentication.py does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from authentication tokens stored in the same token table. An unauthenticated attacker can request /auth/ssh_challenge_token for an arbitrary account by supplying X-Rucio-Account, then present the returned X-Rucio-SSH-Challenge-Token as X-Rucio-Auth-Token to authenticate to other API endpoints as that account, including an administrative account. This issue is fixed in versions 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1.

curation.reason_ko: Rucio가 SSH 인증 도전값과 인증 토큰을 구별하지 않아 비인증 공격자가 관리자 계정을 사칭할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-116643.description: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

curation.reason_ko: GitHub Enterprise Server에서 신뢰된 SSH 인증서를 가진 조직원이 타인의 비공개 저장소를 읽고 수정할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-131820.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through Slack webhook validity checks, potentially leading to remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required Secret Protection with secret scanning and validity checks for partner patterns enabled. This vulnerability affected all versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, and 3.20.12. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

curation.reason_ko: GitHub Enterprise Server의 특정 비밀 검사 설정에서 저장소 쓰기 권한으로 SSRF·코드 실행 가능성이 있다.

CVE-2026-119192.description: Forge, also called node-forge, is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. Prior to 1.4.1, publicKey.verify() with the default RSASSA-PKCS1-V1_5 scheme in lib/rsa.js parses the recovered DigestInfo with the lenient BER parser asn1.fromDer() and validates its structure with digestInfoValidator without requiring canonical DER bytes. Non-minimal or indefinite lengths, malformed parameter values, and non-canonical object identifier encodings with padded subidentifiers or trailing bytes can leave attacker-controlled data inside an accepted DigestInfo. When the verifying RSA public key uses a low exponent such as e=3, an attacker can use that encoding slack to forge a signature without the private key. The same path is used by X.509 certificate and PKCS#7 signature verification. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.1.

curation.reason_ko: node-forge의 RSA 검증 결함으로 낮은 공개 지수 사용 시 개인키 없이 서명을 위조할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-126969.description: SmarterTools SmarterMail Insufficient Entropy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of SmarterTools SmarterMail. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the generation of Application Passwords. The issue results from using insufficient entropy in the generation of credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-33568.

CVE-2026-67455.description: NVIDIA Model Optimizer for Linux and Windows contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a deserialization of untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.
CVE-2026-67455.summary_ko: Linux 및 Windows용 NVIDIA Model Optimizer에는 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 있다. 악용되면 코드 실행, 데이터 변조, 서비스 거부, 정보 노출로 이어질 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: NVIDIA Model Optimizer의 비신뢰 데이터 역직렬화가 코드 실행·데이터 변조·정보 노출로 이어질 수 있다.

CVE-2026-105929.description: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

curation.reason_ko: ansible-core의 역할 의존성 경로 검증 누락으로 설치 시 지정 디렉터리 밖에 파일을 쓸 수 있다.

1cc4d6dc514f83f56f94a388.summary_ko: 국가정보원이 국가·공공기관 대민 웹사이트의 개인용 공동인증서를 클라우드 방식으로 전환해 전자서명 프로그램 설치를 줄이는 가이드를 공개했다. 키보드 보안·백신은 선택 사항으로 두고 문서보안은 무설치 방식을 우선 검토하며, 모든 대상 사이트에 공통으로 적용되는 전환 완료일은 제시하지 않았다.

6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.title_original: Rapid7 Detected Exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 against Atlassian Confluence Data Center, N-able N-central also Exploited
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.excerpt: Overview On November 6, 2026, the Apache Software Foundation disclosed CVE-2026-90436 , a critical unsafe reflection vulnerability ( CWE-470 ) in Axis 1.x that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). Apache Axis is a Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) implementation used for the creation of Java Web services. CISA has assigned CVE-2026-90436 a CVSS score of 9.8 Critical . Since the initial November 6 disclosure, it has transpired that some versions of Atlassian Confluence Data Center and N-able N-central use the affected Axis library and are vulnerable to CVE-2026-90436. Both products require a non-default configuration in order to be vulnerable. CVE-2026-90436 is now being actively exploited in the wild against both known affected products. On November 13, 2026, Rapid7 MDR detected exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 against Atlassian Confluence Data Center in a customer environment. Separately, on November 13, 2026, N-able reported exploitation in the wild against N-central for a vulnerability that strongly correlates to CVE-2026-90436. A proof-of-concept exploit that leverages CVE-2026-90436 and targets N-central was published on November 12, 2026, as part of a series of public zero-day disclosures against N-central. Rapid7 recommends remediating exposed systems on an emergency basis outside of normal patching cycles. Mitigation guidance Prioritize internet-accessible instances with the relevant APIs enabled, and check internal deployments as well. Apply the p
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.summary_ko: Rapid7은 Apache Axis의 비인증 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-90436을 악용한 Confluence Data Center 공격을 탐지했다고 밝혔다. N-able도 N-central에서 해당 취약점과 연관성이 높은 공격을 보고했으며, 두 제품 모두 특정 비기본 설정에서 영향을 받는다. Confluence는 9.2.28 등으로 업데이트하고, N-central은 Legacy API 비활성화 등 공급사 지침을 따라야 한다.
6cebb09b0a2a9ddd2f4efb96.background_ko: 두 제품의 일부 버전이 취약한 Apache Axis 라이브러리를 사용하며, Confluence의 원격 API나 N-central의 Legacy API가 활성화된 경우 취약점에 노출된다.

curation.reason_ko: 특정 설정의 Confluence·N-central에서 취약점 악용이 보고돼 노출 시스템 대응이 시급하다.

7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.title_original: From view-only access to container root: five vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs (FIXED)
7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.excerpt: Overview As part of our research into Zimbra Collaboration Suite , Rapid7 reported five findings in ONLYOFFICE Docs. An attacker with view-only access to a document can chain vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root inside the official DocumentServer container. The findings also expose server files and document data that the viewer never displays, even when downloading is disabled. CVE Finding CVSS CVE-2026-113627 DocBuilder native file read and Session JWT forgery 7.1 High CVE-2026-110385 DocBuilder SaveFile conversion parameter injection and code execution 8.7 High CVE-2026-97727 Complete-save format path traversal and arbitrary file write 6.5 Medium CVE-2026-113630 Root-helper command injection 7.8 High CVE-2026-113631 View-only export of non-rendered document data 6.5 Medium ONLYOFFICE confirmed on October 23, 2026 that all five findings were fixed in Document Server 10.0. The changelog describes the release's security changes. Proof-of-concept code is available on the accompanying Github repository . Product description ONLYOFFICE Docs provides online viewers and editors for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, forms and PDFs. It supports collaborative editing and can integrate with applications that store and share files. An integrating application, for example Zimbra Collaboration Suite, supplies an opening configuration identifying the document and the user's permissions, signed with the Browser key. 7f022dc18f76e8f2488a1b77.summary_ko: Rapid7은 ONLYOFFICE Docs 취약점 5건을 연계해 문서 열람 권한만으로 공식 DocumentServer 컨테이너에서 root 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다고 밝혔다. 재현은 9.4.0-129에서 이뤄졌으며, ONLYOFFICE는 10.0에서 모두 수정했다고 확인했다.

96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.title_original: VU#604762: Multiple vendors vulnerable to Unicode Normalization Collision on macOS (APFS)
96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.excerpt: Overview A mismatch between Apple File System (APFS) filesystem and path resolution for multiple applications allows attackers to bypass security exclusions using alternative Unicode spellings. By supplying an alternative Unicode spelling or case-folded variant (such as ß versus ss ) that bypasses the application's file write checks, a local attacker can overwrite files wherever the process has write permissions, potentially leading to data corruption, configuration hijacking, or code execution. Multiple vendors have assigned CVEs and issued patches to address this flaw. Description Several archive tools, packaging systems, and runtimes enforce exclusion filters using pathname comparisons that do not match the underlying filesystem's resolution behavior. By using a byte-for-byte comparison (such as ß versus ss ), rather than full case folding, a vulnerable application can be tricked into silently overwriting protected files. This vulnerability exposes backup tools, forensic workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to unauthorized file modification. The CVEs assigned during coordination are as follows: CVE-2026-14978 HashiCorp go-slug could allow an attacker with local filesystem access to bypass .terraformignore exclusions and cause sensitive files to be included in Terraform slug uploads due to improper handling of Unicode normalization during path matching. 96255e53b21a719c0af6fa9b.summary_ko: CERT/CC는 APFS의 파일명 해석과 애플리케이션의 경로 비교 방식이 달라 파일 제외 규칙과 접근 제한을 우회할 수 있다고 경고했다. Deno·Libarchive·setuptools·HashiCorp go-slug 등이 관련되며, 파일 덮어쓰기나 배포물에 민감 파일이 포함되는 문제가 발생할 수 있어 영향받는 소프트웨어의 업데이트를 권고했다.

af5f019d5accf432b8239e5d.title_original: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
af5f019d5accf432b8239e5d.excerpt: In this article Phishing attack overview Attack chain overview Mitigation and protection guidance References Learn More On November 13, 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed a coordinated, high-volume phishing campaign targeting organizations across multiple sectors worldwide. The threat actors used phishing emails disguised as legitimate Microsoft 365 service-health notifications to lure recipients into clicking a malicious link. The messages created a false sense of urgency by claiming that emails had been held during a service disruption and would be deleted within 24 hours unless the recipient took action to restore them. This is consistent with historical attacker campaigns which continuously look for notable global events to exploit in their social engineering lures. Microsoft identified the threat actor’s use of specific sender domain names, randomized outage subjects, recipient-specific tracking links, and a common non-Microsoft destination to make the messages appear relevant while complicating simple pattern matching. We assess that the activity was likely credential phishing; however, the available evidence does not confirm credential capture, malware delivery, or post-compromise activity. Multiple threat actors may continue to look for ways to exploit notable global events in any social engineering pretext. 6ba90eb6c72aab685e8d8da9.summary_ko: 로이터는 논문·특허·채용 공고 등 300여 건을 분석해 중국 기업과 연구진이 미국 AI 모델의 출력을 수집·가공하는 증류 작업을 개발 공정으로 체계화했다고 보도했다. 증류 자체는 불법이 아니지만, OpenAI와 Anthropic은 자사 출력을 경쟁 모델 개발·학습에 사용하는 행위를 약관으로 제한한다.

65a8a7f4f3c18f0864902b37.title_ko: 애플, 건강 AI 연구용 앱 출시…미국 성인 최대 20만명 모집
65a8a7f4f3c18f0864902b37.summary_ko: 애플이 OpenEvidence와 건강 AI 연구용 앱을 출시하고 미국 내 21세 이상 이용자를 최대 20만명 모집한다. 12개월 이상 이용자의 이해도와 신뢰, 건강 관리 행동을 살피고, 동의한 참가자의 HealthKit 데이터를 반영한 답변의 유용성도 평가한다. 애플은 연구 데이터를 AI 학습에 사용하지 않으며 앱이 의료진의 조언을 대체하지 않는다고 밝혔다.

83cbd36bde8fe9c2dab8ad44.summary_ko: 제68회 TOP500에서 신규 진입 슈퍼컴퓨터는 27대로, 1993년 집계 시작 이후 가장 적었다. KISTI의 '한강'은 342.6페타플롭스로 세계 12위이자 신규 진입 시스템 중 최고 순위를 기록했다. 전체 500대의 합산 연산 성능은 지난 6월보다 4.4% 증가한 19.57엑사플롭스로 집계됐다.
83cbd36bde8fe9c2dab8ad44.background_ko: TOP500은 신규 시스템 감소의 주요 원인으로 전통적인 슈퍼컴퓨터보다 AI 데이터센터에 투자가 집중되는 흐름을 지목했다.

f602ef26cf6bdabaa8d3e0b3.title_original: 구글 위협 인텔리전스 그룹, 'AI 위협 추적 보고서' 발표...사람 개입 없는 자율 공격 현실화
f602ef26cf6bdabaa8d3e0b3.excerpt: 구글 위협 인텔리전스 그룹(GTIG)이 지난 9월 발표 이후 최신 AI 위협 동향을 분석한 'AI 위협 추적 보고서(AI Threat Tracker)'를 공개했다고 17일 밝혔다.이번 보고서에서 GTIG와 Mandiant(맨디언트)는 사이버 범죄, 첩보, 정보작전(IO) 영역의 공격자들이 생성형 AI를 활용해 공격 시간을 줄이고 작전 규모를 키우며 기계 속도로 다단계 침투를 수행하는 양상을 분석했다. 공격 기법이 단순 프롬프트 입력을 넘어 자율형 멀티 에이전트 프레임워크와 자동화된 취약점 악용 파이프라인, 새로운 수익화 모델로 이동
f602ef26cf6bdabaa8d3e0b3.title_ko: 구글 GTIG, AI 위협 보고서 공개…사람 개입 없는 취약점 악용 사례 보고
f602ef26cf6bdabaa8d3e0b3.summary_ko: 구글 위협 인텔리전스 그룹(GTIG)과 Mandiant는 공격자들이 멀티 에이전트와 취약점 악용 자동화로 침투 속도와 규모를 키우고 있다고 분석했다. GTIG는 사람이 개입하지 않고 취약점을 찾아 공격 코드를 개발한 사례를 확인했다고 밝혔으며, LLM 접근 권한 재판매와 가짜 계정 운영 등도 보고했다.
f602ef26cf6bdabaa8d3e0b3.background_ko: 공격자들의 AI 활용이 단순 프롬프트 입력에서 자율형 멀티 에이전트와 취약점 악용 자동화로 확대되고 있다는 것이 보고서의 분석이다.

3ee29c00c87704b4e236031a.title_original: SM솔루션즈, 운영서버 취약점 실시간 관리 솔루션 '센티온 서버실드' 출시

3ee29c00c87704b4e236031a.title_ko: SM솔루션즈, 운영 서버 취약점 관리 솔루션 ‘센티온 서버실드’ 출시
3ee29c00c87704b4e236031a.summary_ko: SM솔루션즈가 운영 서버의 소프트웨어 구성과 취약점, 보안 패치 적용 여부를 상시 점검하는 ‘센티온 서버실드’를 출시했다. 서버별 SBOM 생성과 CVE·CISA KEV 목록 연동을 지원하며, 회사는 GS인증 1등급 획득과 나라장터 디지털서비스몰 등록도 마쳤다고 밝혔다.
3ee29c00c87704b4e236031a.background_ko: 패치가 나와도 제때 적용하기 어려운 운영 서버의 관리 공백을 메우고 개발부터 운영까지 공급망 보안을 통합 관리하려는 제품이다.

3d82168aced3364fe71b1799.title_original: 씨라이프 부산 아쿠아리움 고객정보 유출…예약시스템 운영사 해킹
3d82168aced3364fe71b1799.excerpt: 씨라이프(SEA LIFE) 부산 아쿠아리움의 입장객 예약시스템 운영사가 해킹 공격을 받아 일부 고객의 개인정보가 외부에 노출되는 사고가 발생했다. 앞서 레고랜드 코리아에서도 동일한 티켓팅 시스템 운영사의 침해사고로 고객정보 유출 가능성이 확인된 만큼 국내 관광·레저시설로 피해가 확대될 가능성에 관심이 집중되고 있다.씨라이프 부산 아쿠아리움은 공식 홈페이지에 ‘고객 개인정보 유출 가능성 안내’를 게시하고, 지난 11월 14일 입장객 예약시스템 운영사인 액세소(Accesso)의 티켓팅 시스템에서 보안 침해사고가 발생해 일부 고객정보가
3d82168aced3364fe71b1799.title_ko: 씨라이프 부산, 외부 예약시스템 침해로 고객정보 유출 가능성 공지
3d82168aced3364fe71b1799.summary_ko: 씨라이프 부산 아쿠아리움은 예약시스템 운영사 Accesso에 대한 해킹으로 일부 연간이용권 고객정보가 조회됐다고 밝혔다. 대상 항목은 성명과 암호화된 생년월일, 연락처 등 6개이며, 정확한 규모와 개별 고객의 실제 유출 여부는 조사 중이다. 현재까지 신용카드·은행 계좌 정보가 노출됐다는 증거는 발견되지 않았다.
3d82168aced3364fe71b1799.background_ko: 외부 공격자가 예약시스템 운영사 Accesso의 티켓팅 시스템에 무단 접속해 일부 연간이용권 고객정보를 조회하면서 발생했다.

curation.reason_ko: Accesso 침해 여파로 국내 예약 고객정보 조회가 확인됐으며 정확한 규모와 개별 유출 여부는 조사 중이다.

ace073fbdee1853f566dea38.title_original: 데이터 오케스트레이션부터 수랭식 스토리지까지...델 테크놀로지스, AI 인프라 포트폴리오 공개
ace073fbdee1853f566dea38.excerpt: 델 테크놀로지스(Dell Technologies)가 기업의 에이전틱 AI 도입과 확장을 지원하는 '엔비디아 기반 델 AI 팩토리(Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA)' 포트폴리오를 강화했다고 17일 밝혔다.이번 발표는 대규모 데이터 준비, 인프라 관리 효율화, 검증된 풀스택 솔루션 제공을 통해 개념검증(PoC) 단계의 AI를 실제 운영 환경으로 전환하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 델은 해당 플랫폼 출시 이후 데이터, 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹 등 전 영역에서 420개 이상의 제품을 선보였으며 현재 6,500개 이상의 고객을 확보했다.
ace073fbdee1853f566dea38.title_ko: 델, AI 팩토리 확장…데이터 오케스트레이션·액체 냉각 스토리지 추가
ace073fbdee1853f566dea38.summary_ko: 델 테크놀로지스가 NVIDIA 기반 AI 팩토리에 데이터 오케스트레이션, 액체 냉각 스토리지, 인프라 관리 자동화 기능을 추가했다. 기업 데이터를 외부로 옮기지 않는 처리와 AI 에이전트의 데이터 접근 관리를 지원하며, 파트너 솔루션과 구축 서비스도 확대했다.
ace073fbdee1853f566dea38.background_ko: 기업의 AI를 개념검증 단계에서 실제 운영 환경으로 전환하도록 데이터 준비와 인프라 관리, 검증된 풀스택 솔루션 제공을 강화했다.

curation.reason_ko: 델이 데이터 오케스트레이션과 액체 냉각 스토리지를 추가해 기업 AI 인프라 구축 선택지를 확대했다.

357092532ce8439de1b22994.title_ko: 데이터이쿠, 코딩 에이전트와 데이터·AI 거버넌스 연결하는 헤드리스 출시
357092532ce8439de1b22994.summary_ko: 데이터이쿠가 자연어 에이전트 코빌드를 개발자용 코딩 도구와 연결하는 ‘데이터이쿠 헤드리스’를 출시했다. Claude Code·Codex 등에서 데이터 파이프라인과 모델을 구축하면 팀원이 화면에서 검토할 수 있는 프로젝트 자산으로 생성하며, 외부 워크플로우 이전과 운영 오류 진단도 지원한다.
357092532ce8439de1b22994.background_ko: 코딩 에이전트로 스크립트를 만드는 속도는 빨라졌지만, 비개발자가 결과물을 이해·검토하고 조직 전체의 업무에 적용하기 어렵다는 한계를 해결하기 위해 출시됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 코딩 에이전트 결과를 팀이 검토할 수 있는 데이터 프로젝트 자산으로 연결하는 제품이 출시됐다.

a826e4d3372401496859603a.title_original: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
a826e4d3372401496859603a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. 2f130cf7f1215ac1f801a939.title_original: How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI
2f130cf7f1215ac1f801a939.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm human cases. Because of the difficulties with a normative account, we instead propose a research program to explore descriptive moral agency. Most basically, we ask, what are the capabilities we humans possess that underlie our moral agency? To do so, we draw on historical scholarship in philosophy and moral psychology to isolate candidate capabilities. Then we suggest refining candidate capabilities so that they are testable in the context of AI systems. Finally, we offer specific empirical recommendations to test AI systems, especially large language models (LLMs), for those refined capabilities. Our approach offers several benefits. Firstly, it may demonstrate whether the behaviors of AI systems are aligned, or in a broad sense desirable. Secondly, the debate may inform policy questions (e.g., what models should be deployed in which contexts?). Thirdly, our approach may complement engineering and design efforts: when capabilities can be precisely characterized, they can inform the development of models. Fourthly, applying our moral reasoning concepts in the new context of AI systems should improve our understanding of those concepts.

556375d7f55e2fa9f0c6a674.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. 280983c701a8e77c10cc1858.title_original: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
280983c701a8e77c10cc1858.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

6d5cffc16e4f2b64ebe05677.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics, offering limited insight into how efficiently a model converges toward a single user-intended interpretation through interaction. We introduce a preference-grounded simulated user framework for controlled, multi-turn evaluation of ambiguity resolution, grounding simulator responses strictly in user disambiguation preferences to avoid hallucination and over-disclosure. Alongside this, we define three observable dissatisfaction signals --- incorrect assumptions, repeating clarifications, and irrelevant clarifications --- that characterize interaction quality beyond task accuracy. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off: models that frequently seek clarification tend to over-clarify and prolong interactions, while assumption-driven models are more prone to misaligning with user intent. We demonstrate that system prompts optimized on these dissatisfaction signals achieve a Pareto-optimal balance across all three metrics, reducing overall error rates by up to 7.65%, underscoring the value of our framework in designing agents that ask precisely and assume wisely.

f090334edb949d8a7a256895.title_original: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
f090334edb949d8a7a256895.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18908v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. d8845f3a27fb7aa095594ea0.title_original: Between Rigor and Reality: How AI Safety Benchmark Developers Understand Benchmark Use and Maintenance
d8845f3a27fb7aa095594ea0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Safety benchmarks are cited as the primary tool to understand the risks posed by generative AI (GenAI) systems, yet growing evidence suggests they often fail to meet the needs of real-world safety evaluation. We present findings from five interviews with AI safety benchmark developers in academia and industry. We find a disconnect between perceptions of the intended usefulness of safety benchmarks and their practical usefulness in safety evaluations of deployed systems. Our participants offered perspectives on two challenges contributing to this disconnect: (1) the difficulty of achieving inter-rater reliability on safety constructs, and (2) a lack of clarity regarding how to address persistent threats to external validity. Based on our analysis, we argue that safety benchmarks must not only be grounded in deployment contexts, but actively integrated with them. To facilitate this, we outline pathways for more transparent communication between academic and industry AI safety stakeholders.

11fa8ae2ad8ce696b354b53d.title_original: Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications
11fa8ae2ad8ce696b354b53d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model (MLM)-aided token reconstruction. In the proposed framework, the receiver detects unreliable token positions from channel reliability and constructs a vocabulary-level channel-posterior. In particular, within the receiver, Posterior-Weighted Input Embedding (PWE) injects this posterior into the MLM input, while Adaptive Output Logit Fusion (AOF) reuses it at the output with a channel-adaptive weight. Consequently, multiple unreliable tokens can be reconstructed in a single bidirectional MLM inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional MLM training. Experiments over noisy channels show up to a $67.2$\% improvement in cosine similarity over context-only MLM reconstruction, with consistent gains across different MLM architectures and existing language-model-aided methods.

4d8f396a7f75b13ca4d956c5.title_original: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
4d8f396a7f75b13ca4d956c5.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18963v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. 0b8f1a8c7e033ba8437ba6a0.title_original: Three Invisible Failure Modes in Speech-Based Age Estimation for Child Safety
0b8f1a8c7e033ba8437ba6a0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.18971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Child safety in AI depends on the accurate identification of minor users. A second model's endpoint was replaced by a successor that refused nearly every age-related question and never produced an age. Every model sometimes placed the same speech sample under 13 and over 18 years of age, but a third model went further, giving threshold answers that contradicted its own numeric estimates. None of these failure modes produced a warning, a status code, or a change in output format, so they would all pass standard monitoring. 1de232313862fa14e9ac6c64.title_original: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
1de232313862fa14e9ac6c64.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. a00e71c294eb79e3f15c2de6.title_original: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
a00e71c294eb79e3f15c2de6.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. fc548a7f3aea43720344d5e5.title_original: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
fc548a7f3aea43720344d5e5.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. 46db9bc70b38c88b0d0c38f5.title_original: CONTEXT-PCa: Evaluating the role of clinical context in MRI-based AI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (study protocol)
46db9bc70b38c88b0d0c38f5.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate the role of clinical variables - their breadth, source, and quality - in the development, utility, and generalisability of an AI system for bi-parametric MRI (bpMRI)-based diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). Clinical context is added to the published PI-CAI-2B image-only model, whose weights are fixed. The study cohort comprises 6,022 biparametric MRI cases from 4,540 patients at University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2019-2024), of which 4,834 cases (3,632 patients) are held out for internal testing. Forty-three clinical variables are drawn from structured health records, clinical letters, MRI reports, and automated image measurements. The primary endpoint is the difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) between the image-context and image-only models on the internal test set. Secondary analyses compare combining strategies, the contribution of individual variables, and performance across subgroups. All models are further tested on five external cohorts from primary diagnosis and population-based screening.

cabcf5fca502ae0505df8af9.title_original: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
cabcf5fca502ae0505df8af9.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.

f850ea4e141b6349d1935c84.title_original: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
f850ea4e141b6349d1935c84.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.

5b7adb2b81ed43fe4ba78f7f.title_original: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
5b7adb2b81ed43fe4ba78f7f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. b1a4505045a01d771ed11e05.title_original: Conditional Endorsement: Simulating How Adults with Different Skills Evaluate Canada's National AI Strategy
b1a4505045a01d771ed11e05.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, AI for All, commits to free AI training for everyone and to expanding business AI adoption, yet it is difficult to anticipate whether these policies will reach adults with uneven skills and circumstances. We ask how adults with diverse skills might rate these policies on support, effectiveness, and personal benefit, how their skills and circumstances shape these evaluations, and what implementation conditions they raise. We built 3,200 generative agents from a weighted sample of the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC) Cycle 2 respondents, collected their ratings and explanations for 20 policies, and analyzed dialogues between agents with contrasting ratings. The agents supported nearly every policy but were far less confident that they would improve adult AI literacy or benefit them personally. This gap widened as digital technology use declined: agents modeled on adults who had never used a digital device still endorsed the policies but rarely expected to benefit. Agents traced the gap to participation costs, hard-to-exercise rights, and limited community control, and their dialogues specified these conditions rather than resolving disagreement. We describe this pattern as conditional endorsement and argue that AI literacy policy should be designed and evaluated for adults with the fewest digital skills.

2a5d965652019fd465937095.title_original: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
2a5d965652019fd465937095.excerpt: arXiv:2611.19115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO).
